relevance_note: Single case report of a girl with a clinical (imaging-based) diagnosis of ATS: 'The findings of severe vascular malformation with tortuosity, elongation and aneurysm formation were suggestive of ATS'; SLC2A10 testing was declined, so no variant is reported.
method_note: Hand extraction, no table transcription. One in-scope person (rule 5 label 'patient'); in scope by clinical diagnosis of ATS, not by a variant. No variants rows: genetic screening for SLC2A10 was recommended but declined by the family; the Discussion's 'It is therefore likely that in our patient ATS was associated with a mutation in the SLC2A10 gene' is speculation, not a finding, so no variant row with 'not reported' was created. Diagnosis wording is 'suggestive of ATS' (clinical/angiographic only). age_at_last_evaluation is the age at admission ('10-year old'); a 1-year follow-up is mentioned without an age, so the true last-evaluation age is not stated. Vital status not stated explicitly (left not reported despite 1-year follow-up). 'there were no connective tissue manifestations' and 'other physical examinations were within normal limits' are global statements; per D-27 recorded only as written (connective tissue manifestations excluded) and not used to exclude specific checklist items (cutis laxa, joint hypermobility, hernias, skeletal features). 'skin was soft' is not hyperextensible/lax skin, so that checklist item is not reported. Routine hematological/urine tests and chest x-ray recorded as broad normal results only. Brain MRI 'arteriovenous malformations' and the small ACA aneurysm are not on the checklist; recorded as phenotypic_features only. No contradictions found.
